stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “The guide said restorers did not hide every crack”?
options: The repair itself was part of the object's history
The damage told part of the story
The real goal is not only to fix objects
They help people remember what time has taken away

本文沒有陳述「The damage told part of the story」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The real goal is not only to fix objects」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
